verdict.rationale: LibreChat is documented as a self-hosted web app that you install on your own machine or cluster via Docker, npm, or Helm, so conversation data is stored wherever the user deploys it. Custom endpoints such as Ollama also let model traffic stay on infrastructure the user controls. missing for 10: explicit data-residency/region documentation, guidance on where data goes when third-party LLM APIs are used, independent corroboration of residency control.
